name: osreboot
description: Image server and live status page for a machine that restores its own system

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p server && tsc --noEmit -p server/web && tsc --noEmit -p extra/paper
scripts.build: tsc -p server/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p server/web && cp server/web/*.html server/web/style.css server/dist/web/
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run build && tsx watch server/src/server.ts
